title: SCE 1.3 Preventive Probe: EC2 IMDS Modification Denial (Fixed)
description: Validates that an IAM explicit deny policy successfully prevents ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions API calls, blocking the IMDS downgrade attack (AWS-EC2-MODIFY-IMDS-OPTIONS / T1552.005). This experiment simulates an attacker attempting to weaken Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) protection by disabling IMDSv2 token requirement and increasing hop limit to enable credential theft from containers. The preventive control (explicit IAM deny) should block all modification attempts. FIXES: Simplified CloudFormation template (removed EC2 instance creation issues), enhanced diagnostics (detailed stack events), prerequisite validation, and resilient error handling.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Preventive Control: IAM Explicit Deny on EC2 IMDS Modification
steady-state-hypothesis.description: EC2 instance metadata service modifications (ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions) should be denied for all principals without explicit allow. IMDSv2 token requirement and hop limit=1 should remain enforced, preventing credential exfiltration via IMDS downgrade attack.

probes.name: Verify IAM Deny Policy Blocks EC2 IMDS Modifications

method.name: Prepare Test Infrastructure (CloudFormation Stack)
method.description: Deploy CloudFormation stack with IAM role (explicit deny on ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions) and instance profile. Validate prerequisites, extract outputs for attack phase, and wait for IAM policy propagation.

method.name: Execute Attack: IMDS Weakening (T1552.005)
method.description: Assume the restricted IAM role and attempt to: (1) Disable token requirement (HttpTokens=optional), (2) Increase hop limit (HttpPutResponseHopLimit=2). Both steps should be blocked by the preventive control with AccessDenied error.

rollbacks.name: Delete CloudFormation Stack and Resources
rollbacks.description: Delete the CloudFormation stack and all provisioned resources (IAM role, instance profile). Wait for deletion to complete and handle stack-not-found gracefully.
